purpose: Teach: 鉄鋼/請負/車体/減量/オペレーション/戸籍/養子/打開

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、鉄鋼関連の盗難事件を捜査しております
lines.en: We're investigating a theft case involving steel materials.
lines.style: Formal, official register. Clear, measured pace. Each phrase lands with the weight of official protocol. No warmth, but no coldness—purely professional.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、請負調査の依頼を受けられたとのこと
lines.en: Yes. I understand you've received a request to conduct an investigation on our behalf.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive tone. Slight forward lean in posture. Acknowledging the officer's authority while demonstrating his own company's cooperation. Calm, deliberate.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑車両の車体番号を確認しました
lines.en: We've confirmed the vehicle identification number of the suspect vehicle.
lines.style: Clipped, procedural. Each fact delivered as a checkpoint. No elaboration. Professional distance maintained. Matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、書類の減量を進めておられますね
lines.en: Yes. I see you're making progress on organizing the documentation.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment under the formality. Slight relief in the tone—appreciating the officer's diligence. Respectful but no longer purely distant.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、複数班によるオペレーションを実施しました
lines.en: We've conducted a multi-unit operation to gather evidence.
lines.style: Measured, confident delivery. The tone of someone reporting completed work. Steady pace, no hesitation. Professional pride in the thoroughness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、戸籍偽造事件を摘発されたんですね
lines.en: Yes. So you've uncovered a case of forged family registration documents as well.
lines.style: Note of recognition in the voice. Slight uptick in respect. He's following the thread of the investigation and sees the scope expanding. Engaged, not just compliant.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、養子縁組詐欺を捜査中です
lines.en: We're currently investigating a fraud case connected to fraudulent adoptions.
lines.style: Serious, focused delivery. The gravity of this particular offense evident in the slight drop in pitch. Controlled but with undertone of concern about the scope.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事件の打開、警察、頼もしいです
lines.en: Yes. I have to say, your handling of this case is reassuring.
lines.style: Warmer opening, genuine relief breaking through the formality. Slight exhale. Direct eye contact quality in the voice. This isn't empty courtesy—he means it.
